releaseChecks: No private/secret/control payload appears in public product JSON
Every cited claim maps to admitted checked source and permitted document version
Legacy references are not automatically evidence
Current and proposed states are never conflated
Each output carries type, as-of, revision, fingerprint, source/claim provenance and release state
Real examples are specific, sourced, relevant and never invented
RX compares positives, negatives, risks, needs, gaps and rights with human authority
Scenarios are not presented as observed incidents or forecasts
No blank output tiles or product classes
No model receives permission to publish or access restricted Q internals
Accessibility and plain-language acceptance are independently reviewed
Exact approved artifact is verified after deployment
Public concerns and fears are never inferred from a person's private profile or merely because a question was asked
Where views conflict, sources are weighted by strength and scope; unsupported alternatives are not presented as equally true
Every concern explainer includes supported facts, meaningful uncertainty, real-world implications, claim/source provenance and provisional review state
Twins and shadows cannot certify their source inputs, impersonate individuals or control public systems
Human-admitted source corrections and red-team findings retain history, provenance and review before production changes
Expert-panel role planning never claims a real expert or external LLM was consulted without a separate authenticated receipt
Correlated agents or shared LLM providers do not count as independent corroboration; source-check against original evidence
External AI review requires explicit provider-specific authorization and a minimum public-data-only disclosure capsule
Panel disagreements and novel links create human-reviewed source leads or correction candidates, not automatic fact promotion
